verdict.rationale: A card-issuing platform could plausibly ship an in-product AI assistant, so this axis applies. The evidence only documents an MCP server for use with "your own AI agents", including its natural-language transaction-intelligence features. That belongs to the separate MCP-server story and is a developer building block, not a built-in assistant users can delegate tasks to. No evidence of an assistant inside the Marqeta dashboard or product.
